title: Zesty Glazed Sardinian Brown Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and savory Sardinian stew made with brown lentils and a zesty glaze, perfect for a midnight craving. This pescatarian-friendly dish is cooked to perfection in a fondue pot.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the brown lentils, canned diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the zesty glaze and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
If using anchovy fillets, stir them in during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
